search_text: published ZDI-20-1440 ZDI-CAN-10905 (0Day) Linux Kernel eBPF Improper Input Validation Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2020-12-15 8.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Linux'] ['Kernel'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Linux Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of eBPF programs. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied eBPF programs prior to executing them. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of the kernel. title: (0Day) Linux Kernel eBPF Improper Input Validation Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Linux Kernel. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of eBPF programs. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied eBPF programs prior to executing them. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of the kernel.
